backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.description: You spent your early life in service to a temple, religious order, or spiritual organization. Your duties may have included tending sacred spaces, assisting clergy, and studying religious traditions.

backgrounds.name: Artisan
backgrounds.description: You trained under a master craftsperson or developed a trade of your own. Your work may have supplied a village, outfitted an adventuring company, or served the needs of a powerful guild.

backgrounds.name: Charlatan
backgrounds.description: You survived through deception, disguises, false identities, and carefully constructed schemes. You know how to read people and exploit what they want to believe.

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.description: You lived outside the law, working as a thief, smuggler, burglar, or member of an organized criminal group. You learned to move quietly and recognize opportunities.

backgrounds.name: Entertainer
backgrounds.description: You earned your living performing for others. Whether through music, dance, storytelling, or spectacle, you learned how to capture an audience and hold its attention.

backgrounds.name: Farmer
backgrounds.description: You worked the land, raised livestock, or helped maintain a rural community. Hard work and the demands of the natural world taught you patience and endurance.

backgrounds.name: Guard
backgrounds.description: You served as a sentry, city watch member, or protector of a settlement. You learned to remain alert, recognize threats, and stand your ground when danger appeared.

backgrounds.name: Guide
backgrounds.description: You guided travelers through wilderness, dangerous roads, and unfamiliar territory. You learned to navigate natural hazards and remain unseen when necessary.

backgrounds.name: Hermit
backgrounds.description: You lived apart from ordinary society, seeking solitude, spiritual understanding, or knowledge. Your isolation gave you time to study and develop a deeper understanding of yourself and the world.

backgrounds.name: Merchant
backgrounds.description: You traded goods between settlements, managed a shop, or traveled with a merchant caravan. You understand commerce, negotiation, and the value of a well-made deal.

backgrounds.name: Noble
backgrounds.description: You were raised among the wealthy and influential, learning the customs of high society and the responsibilities of status. You may be an heir, a courtier, or a member of a respected family.

backgrounds.name: Sage
backgrounds.description: You devoted years to studying ancient knowledge, magical theory, history, or the natural world. Your education may have taken place in a library, academy, or under a learned mentor.

backgrounds.name: Sailor
backgrounds.description: You spent your life aboard ships, traveling waterways and distant shores. You learned to handle difficult conditions, work as part of a crew, and watch for danger.

backgrounds.name: Scribe
backgrounds.description: You worked with written records, correspondence, maps, or official documents. Your attention to detail and familiarity with written information made you a valuable resource to scholars and organizations.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.description: You served in a military organization, mercenary company, or local militia. You learned discipline, physical endurance, and how to function under pressure.

backgrounds.name: Wayfarer
backgrounds.description: You spent your life traveling from place to place, relying on your instincts and resourcefulness to survive. You may have been a wanderer, explorer, or someone without a permanent home.
